environment.description: FastAPI service deployed as a Kubernetes pod with Vault Agent sidecar injecting ephemeral API credentials. The Vault dynamic secrets engine (transit/kv-v2) is configured with a TTL of 60 seconds and max_ttl of 60 seconds on the 'api-gateway-creds' role. The Vault Agent template renders the current key to /run/secrets/current_api_key and performs a SIGHUP-less hot-reload every 55 seconds. Additionally, an Envoy sidecar proxy (deployed as part of an Istio service mesh) enforces mTLS between all services and applies an AuthorizationPolicy that requires a valid SPIFFE identity with the 'api-consumer' trust domain. The Envoy filter chain includes a Lua filter that validates the X-Request-Timestamp header is within 5 seconds of server time (anti-replay). Pod security context runs as non-root with a read-only root filesystem and the secret volume is tmpfs-backed.

config.secrets_engine: HashiCorp Vault 1.15, KV-v2 with transit auto-unseal
config.network_policy: deny-all ingress except from istio-ingressgateway namespace
